title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Cowork goes cross-device: web + mobile with remote sessions that run when your laptop is closed
bullets.summary: Anthropic is rolling Claude Cowork out to web and mobile (starting with Max), running sessions remotely in beta so sessions and files live in your Claude account and follow you across devices; work continues after you close the laptop and scheduled tasks run with no device online. Doubled Cowork usage limits extended through Aug 5.
bullets.how: This is the platform The Construct runs on. Cloud-hosted, always-on scheduled tasks mean our daily scans (Pulse, Lens, PRAGMA Mirror), Hermes hand-offs, and dashboard refreshes no longer depend on a Mac being awake — the single biggest reliability upgrade to the fleet's cadence. Migrate the scan/deploy schedule to remote sessions and verify the V4 dashboard flow still lands.

bullets.title: Claude adds Microsoft 365 write tools — draft email, manage calendar, edit OneDrive/SharePoint
bullets.summary: The M365 connector moves from read to write: agents can now draft email, create/manage calendar events, and update OneDrive and SharePoint files directly.
bullets.how: If any Construct/Brand 9 Signs workflow touches a Microsoft stack, this closes the loop from 'read context' to 'take action' without a human relay; low priority while we're Google/iCloud-centric, but the pattern — connectors graduating to write access — is the one to watch across our whole registry.

bullets.title: MCP 2026-07-28 spec Release Candidate — stateless core + MCP Apps + Tasks + Extensions
bullets.summary: The RC (final ships Jul 28) drops the initialize handshake and Mcp-Session-Id header so every request is self-contained, adds an Extensions framework, a Tasks lifecycle for long-running server-directed jobs, MCP Apps for sandboxed interactive HTML UIs over the same JSON-RPC consent path, and OAuth/OIDC-aligned auth plus a formal deprecation policy.
bullets.how: A structural change to the substrate our whole MCP fleet runs on; stateless simplifies connector orchestration and Tasks/MCP-Apps map onto how our agents run long jobs and render dashboards. Audit each server against the breaking changes before Jul 28, and eye MCP Apps as a native replacement for hand-built dashboard panels.

bullets.title: Frontier shuffle: GPT-5.6 GA as ChatGPT default; Grok 4.5 tops agentic tool-use at $2/$6 but hallucinates more; Gemini 3.5 Pro now targeting Jul 17
bullets.summary: OpenAI opened GPT-5.6 to GA Jul 9 and made it the ChatGPT default; SpaceXAI's Grok 4.5 (Jul 9, trained with Cursor) ranked #4 on Artificial Analysis with the best agentic tool-use score at $2/$6 per-Mtok but its hallucination rate jumped from 25% to 54%; Gemini 3.5 Pro's GA now points to ~Jul 17.
bullets.how: Routing-layer input: GPT-5.6 is a fresh default to bench, Grok 4.5 is tempting for cheap tool-heavy loops but 54% hallucination makes it unsafe for anything unverified. Keep provider-agnostic routing so each is a config change, and gate high-hallucination models behind verification steps.

bullets.title: arXiv: "From Question Answering to Task Completion — A Survey on Agent System and Harness Design"
bullets.summary: Surveys how agent 'harnesses' (memory, tools, control flow, verification) determine task-completion reliability, moving the frame from model quality to system design.
bullets.how: Our edge is the harness (CLAUDE.md locked rules, agent memories, connector registry, verification steps), not the base model. Use the taxonomy to find harness gaps — especially verification and failure-recovery — and treat harness design as the durable moat as base models commoditize.

praxis_lesson: The afternoon's real story is that The Construct's own substrate got sturdier: Cowork is moving to cloud-hosted, cross-device sessions where scheduled tasks fire with no machine awake, and connectors keep graduating from read to write (M365). Combined with the Jul 28 stateless-MCP RC, the platform is quietly removing the 'is a Mac on?' and 'is this server stateful?' fragilities from the fleet. The move: migrate our scan/deploy schedule onto remote sessions, keep the durable edge in the harness (memory, orchestration, verification), and treat frontier-model churn (GPT-5.6 GA, Grok 4.5's 54% hallucination rate) as swappable config behind provider-agnostic routing.
